content: For biLSTM, each word is represented as a word embedding BIBREF37 , and an average-pooling layer is applied to the word embeddings to obtain the sentence embedding, which is fed into a bi-directional LSTM to generate the document embedding from the sentence embeddings. Then a max-pooling layer is applied to select the most salient features from the component sentences.
